# Social Research Brief

Use this skill when a workflow needs reviewed social evidence before drafting
launch copy, competitive analysis, or sentiment summaries.

## Inputs

- X/Twitter source URLs
- Exported post text and metadata
- TweetClaw evidence packets
- Human-provided campaign notes

## Output

Return a concise brief with source provenance, observed themes, risks, and
approval checkpoints before any publishing or scheduling action.
